description: Discover how we can make our planet cleaner and more sustainable! Our project focuses on recycling waste, reusing synthetic materials, and finding innovative ways to reduce environmental pollution. Join us to turn environmental challenges into practical solutions and build a greener future together.
summary:
ARNA is an intelligent textile recycling ecosystem designed to make clothing collection more accessible, transparent, and sustainable. The project combines smart collection terminals, a digital platform, and resource-efficient technologies to encourage responsible textile consumption and reduce textile waste.

Our solution features smart terminals equipped with QR identification, automated weighing systems, and solar panels to support energy-efficient operation. Through the ARNA website and future mobile application, users can track their collected textiles, monitor their environmental contribution, and earn Eco-coins that can be exchanged for rewards from partner businesses.

The platform also integrates NASA POWER environmental data, including solar radiation and temperature information, to support solar energy planning and provide users with interactive environmental insights. Our digital dashboard connects textile collection statistics with resource monitoring, making the recycling process more transparent and measurable.

ARNA aims to promote a circular economy by extending the life cycle of clothing, supporting textile recycling, and connecting individual actions with broader environmental goals.
details:
ARNA is a smart textile recycling ecosystem designed to make clothing collection more accessible, transparent, and sustainable. The project combines a smart collection terminal with a digital platform that serves as the foundation for a future mobile application.

Our concept includes a terminal where users can deposit unwanted clothing, identify themselves through QR codes, and have their collected textiles weighed automatically. Through the ARNA website, users will be able to access collection statistics, track their environmental contribution, and participate in a reward system called Eco-coins. These points can be exchanged for rewards from partner businesses.

Our team has already developed the ARNA website using JavaScript. We have also created a 3D-printed demonstration model of the collection terminal to present the physical design of our solution. The next development stage is to build a functional terminal with QR identification, automatic weighing, IoT components, and a connection to the digital platform.

The project also incorporates renewable energy through solar panels planned for the collection terminals and recycling facility rooftops. We plan to integrate NASA POWER environmental data, including solar radiation and temperature, to provide environmental insights and support solar energy planning.

ARNA is creative because it combines textile recycling, digital technology, renewable energy, environmental data, and gamification in one ecosystem. During development, our team considered accessibility, energy efficiency, user engagement, transparency, technical feasibility, and future scalability.

Our intended impact is to reduce textile waste, promote responsible clothing consumption, encourage recycling habits, and contribute to a more sustainable circular economy.
